paper.title: EmbedGym: Letting Coding Agents Develop and Debug Embedded Firmware Without Physical Hardware

atmega328p_arduino.notes: MCU twin ATMEGA328P is in CircuitTwin catalog; 29/92 tasks use built-in GPIO/PWM/ADC/UART or official catalog I2C twins (MPU6050, VL53L0X). Remaining 63 tasks require external peripheral models not yet in CircuitTwin catalog.

atmega2560_arduino.notes: MCU twin ATMEGA2560 is in CircuitTwin catalog; 29/92 tasks use built-in GPIO/PWM/ADC/UART or official catalog I2C twins (MPU6050, VL53L0X). Remaining 63 tasks require external peripheral models not yet in CircuitTwin catalog.

esp32s3_arduino.notes: CircuitTwin ships esp32s3-devkitc (ESP32-S3) in its catalog, but upstream EmbedGym does not publish prebuilt .bin binaries (hasFirmware=false for all 2400 runs) and builds with patched Arduino ESP32 v2.0.17 / ESP-IDF v4.4.7 app-start markers not published in EmbedGym.github.io.

esp32s3_espidf.notes: CircuitTwin ships esp32s3-devkitc (ESP32-S3) in its catalog, but upstream EmbedGym does not publish prebuilt .bin binaries (hasFirmware=false for all 2400 runs) and requires patched ESP-IDF v4.4.7 build scripts not published in EmbedGym.github.io.

nrf52840_arduino.notes: CircuitTwin does not currently ship an nRF52840-QIAA twin in its catalog (ct board list reports nrf52840-dk as 'needs twin'; catalog ships nRF52833-QIAA only). Upstream EmbedGym also does not publish prebuilt ELFs for nRF52840 (hasFirmware=false).

nrf52840_zephyr.notes: CircuitTwin does not currently ship an nRF52840-QIAA twin in its catalog (ct board list reports nrf52840-dk as 'needs twin'; catalog ships nRF52833-QIAA only). Upstream EmbedGym also does not publish prebuilt ELFs for nRF52840 (hasFirmware=false).
